newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian police arrest false air traffic controller.
newsitem.headline: Belgian police arrest false air traffic controller.

text.p: A radio pirate who had been posing as an air traffic controller and broadcasting false instructions to pilots for the past three months was arrested on Thursday, the Brussels airport authority said.
The man, who had eluded authorities since October, turned himself in and confessed after reports of his actions appeared in the press on Wednesday.

"The information which I have is that he is a minor. As far as I know he has made a confession, apparently after he realised the implications of what he was doing," Brussels airport authority chairman Eric Kirsch told BRTN radio.
He did not give the man's age or his name.

Kirsch said the man was an aviation buff whose transmissions on sophisticated radio equipment, breaking into the normal air traffic radio frequencies, had threatened to disrupt aircraft landings and cause accidents.
After the existence of the pirate was revealed, the Brussels airport authority insisted there was no actual danger.
